subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as the canonical reaction-specific Slack Socket Mode report until live current-main envelope diagnostics are captured?
rationale: Source inspection proves handler support and plausible drop boundaries, but only live Slack diagnostics can separate upstream non-delivery from OpenClaw filtering or authorization.

options.title: Keep Reaction-Specific Canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open and request redacted raw Socket Mode envelopes plus gateway trace logs before changing code.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Socket Mode Tracking
options.body: Move remaining diagnosis under the broader Slack Socket Mode issue only if maintainers can preserve this reaction-specific evidence there.

options.title: Sponsor Live Maintainer Repro
options.body: Have a maintainer run a current-main multi-account Slack workspace repro to identify the first missing boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep Reaction-Specific Canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and request redacted raw Socket Mode envelopes plus gateway trace logs before changing code.
